name: special_bessel_j0
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::special_bessel_j0(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Computes the Bessel function of the first kind of order zero elementwise without mutating or aliasing the input. The correctness suite covers float32 and float64, the legacy pointwise shapes, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, and NaN/infinity/signed-zero values. Float64 is skipped only on Kunlunxin because that backend silently downgrades it to float32.
